description:
E-Man #9 (December 1983), First Comics - "What th--! It's Tyger Lili!" Written by Martin Pasko, art and cover by Joe Staton. Baxter paper, $1.00 cover price.

Back cover: Warp Special #2 Lord Cumulus (Peter Gillis, Mark Silvestri) house ad.

Condition: clean, bright covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
